# bootstrap-modernized

> Maintained Bootstrap forks modernized for 2026-era stacks, published as the npm package
> `bootstrap-modernized`. Unofficial community fork — not affiliated with the Bootstrap team.
> Two branches carry the work: `v4-modern` (Bootstrap 4 line) and `v5-modern` (Bootstrap 5 line).
> `main` only mirrors upstream and hosts this index.

## Which line to use

- Project uses Bootstrap 4 (e.g. AdminLTE 3, jQuery plugins): use `v4-modern` → `bootstrap-modernized@^4`
- Project uses Bootstrap 5: use `v5-modern` → `bootstrap-modernized@^5`

## Install

```sh
npm install bootstrap-modernized@^4   # Bootstrap 4 line
npm install bootstrap-modernized@^5   # Bootstrap 5 line

# Drop-in alias — keeps every existing "bootstrap" import/require/~bootstrap specifier working:
npm install bootstrap@npm:bootstrap-modernized@^4
npm install bootstrap@npm:bootstrap-modernized@^5
```

## Key facts

- `v4-modern`: Bootstrap 4.6.2 base, version 4.7.x. jQuery 4 support (3 still works), Popper 2,
  byte-identical CSS (golden-tested), AdminLTE 3 verified in CI.
- `v5-modern`: Bootstrap 5.3.8 base, version 5.4.x. Vanilla JS + Popper 2, no jQuery dependency.
- Both lines: Dart Sass 2/3 clean `scss/` (`@import`) plus parallel `scss/module/` tree
  (`@use`/`@forward`, configurable via `with()`), ESM builds with `exports` map, Node.js 22 toolchain.
- MIT licensed. Original copyright: Twitter, Inc. and The Bootstrap Authors.
